text:
mira: quick proposal: regroup left nav into three zones (Workspaces / Registry / Insights) + add an optional skiplink bar for keyboard users. main goals: clearer deep-links, simpler breadcrumbs, predictable keyboard flow.

mira: canonical deep-links we want to support: /app/ws/:wsId, /app/ws/:wsId/registry/:modelId, /app/ws/:wsId/insights/requests?range=30d

jon: eng: path-based routing only. hashes cause history/copy issues. react-router path routes are cleaner for analytics.

priya: PM: agree. we need a redirect shim for existing bookmarked hash links and a banner explaining change. track broken links after rollout.

sam: a11y: skiplinks must be first focusable element. each zone should be role="navigation" with aria-label. breadcrumbs: last crumb aria-current="page". announce truncation via polite live region.

lee: UX: visually omit the intermediate noun in breadcrumbs (show WorkspaceName > ModelName) while keeping full path in URL. truncate middle crumbs to ellipsis on small widths. use chevrons.

jon: plan: implement routes, add client shim that rewrites legacy `/#/` patterns to /app/ via replaceState, and server redirects for direct hits. feature-flag by workspace for canary.

priya: rollout: canary 5% -> 25%. monitor deep-link click success, search for pages, and time-to-first-action. rollback if >15% negative delta.

mira: action items: mira mockups by Wed, jon prototype + shim by Fri, sam a11y checklist + keyboard tests by next Tue, priya customer comms & docs draft by Mon.

docs-bot: created docs stub at /docs/console/nav-ia-migration (please add migration table).

mira: thanks all  closing this thread and will post updated mocks.
